notes.title: Still Alive
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your ongoing support of the seemingly perpetually-in-development Compound Fracture. The game is still alive and the team remains hard at work. There unfortunately isn't much in the way of exciting information to share at this time, but we do have some new screenshots to show.

notes.title: Progress Report
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

Sorry for the lack of updates since entering full time development. We’re still alive and development is steadily proceeding. We have no plans to slow down and remain committed to making Compound Fracture the best we possibly can.

We can’t show a lot in this update but we do have some overhauled dinosaurs to share. These models, textures, and animations have been produced by our new animator who we hope to properly introduce in the future.

[previewyoutube=UR4KCxa87MU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Lack of Updates[/b]
As a small team, we want to spend as much time as possible working on the game itself. Posting updates is unavoidably time consuming, especially as we want to be able to show you substantial updates and not the same old stuff.

[b]Next Update[/b]
Once Compound Fracture begins to more accurately reflect the quality of the final game, we will return to posting about it more frequently. Until then, we thank you for your patience and support even after all these years. We’ve never been more proud of Compound Fracture and can’t wait to show you what we’ve been up to.

- Austin, Cyrus, and Pete

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39869314/a111044630c5466b3001c61ae714e650a612152e.png[/img]

Image text:
After years of scattered progress, recent developments have given the three of us the opportunity to work on Compound Fracture full-time.
We're going to be putting our nose to the grindstone, so expect less frequent updates but know that behind the scenes we will be working harder than we've ever dreamed possible.

We are immensely grateful for your support that has brought us here so please keep an eye out on Steam and Twitter for future updates.

- Austin, Cyrus, and Pete
